name: Mobile PWA Remote Cockpit
description: Build the PWA that serves as a remote cockpit for the desktop. Three-layer model: Projection Stream (cursored state deltas via WebSocket), Command Gateway (capability-scoped intents with replay protection), Notification Gateway (push alerts via Web Push API). QR code pairing flow. Works on iOS 16.4+ Home Screen and Android.
purpose: Give users mobile visibility and control over their desktop agents without building native iOS/Android apps. Desktop stays the execution authority; PWA is a scoped observer and intent-sender.
acceptanceCriteria: QR code pairing flow from desktop to PWA
Projection Stream delivers cursored state deltas via WebSocket
Command Gateway sends capability-scoped intents with idempotency keys
Notification Gateway uses Web Push API for gate-waiting and agent-failed alerts
Phone caches last-known projections locally but discards on reconnect
Desktop offline mode shows cached projections and queued notifications
iOS 16.4+ Home Screen installation required for push notifications
Ionic confined to touch shell only — domain components are pure Lit
